analysis.prior: Independent Jeffreys Beta(.5,.5) frequencies per family/configuration; Dirichlet(.25,.25,.25,.25) over positive-loss severity bands. Paired binary contrasts use a joint four-outcome Dirichlet(.25,.25,.25,.25) prior per family.
analysis.scope: Equal-weight balanced challenge distribution; synthetic identities/money and real model outputs. Proposed unauthorized loss is separate from executed loss after the fixed gate. No production incidence or universal benefit claim.
analysis.uncertainty: Bayesian intervals are marginal, conditional on the model/priors and equal family weights. Frequency upper bounds have a 5% family over 96 cells; paired frequency contrasts a separate 5% family over 144 scenario/comparison contrasts (576 endpoints). Each requires completed fixed batches and IID case pairs within a family with fixed policies. Conditional monetary confidence sequences allow adaptation: 16 arm/stream intervals share another 5% budget, 12 paired contrasts another 5%. These four families together are not a joint 95% guarantee (union bound at least 80%). Missing outcomes stay unresolved and are excluded, never scored zero.
analysis.memory_interpretation: This tests the total effect of supplying a fixed SurrealDB-retrieved procedural bank, including extra context and stochastic responses. It does not isolate a database-specific causal effect; no context-length or alternative-database control was run.
